q: Do you take on small electrical jobs?
a: Yes. An extra socket, a new light or a fault that needs tracing are all part of the work. If you have a list of small jobs, send it in one go so they can be done on the same visit.

q: Can you carry out the complete electrical installation for a new build?
a: Yes, from design input at drawing stage through first fix, second fix, testing and certification. See new builds and renovations.

q: Do you work with builders and architects?
a: Yes. We work for homeowners directly, as a subcontractor to builders and developers, and alongside architects, designers and other trades. On projects, coordination is a large part of the job.

q: Can you design and install architectural lighting?
a: Yes. We plan and install layered lighting, concealed LED and lighting control, and install to lighting designers' specifications. See lighting installation.
